senses.sense_definition: A person who buys tickets to popular events and resells them at inflated prices.

examples.text: We bought our concert tickets outside the venue from a <w>scalper</w> for twice the normal price.
Many fans were angry that online <w>scalpers</w> bought up all the seats within seconds.

senses.sense_definition: A person who buys scarce goods, such as electronics or collectibles, to resell them at a large profit.

examples.text: During the holiday season, every <w>scalper</w> tried to resell the newest gaming console for double the retail price.
Stores introduced limits on purchases to prevent a <w>scalper</w> from emptying the shelves.

senses.sense_definition: A financial trader who executes rapid, short-term trades to profit from small price changes.

examples.text: As an active day trader, the <w>scalper</w> made dozens of small transactions throughout the morning.
A professional <w>scalper</w> relies on high-speed internet and instant market data to capture minor gains.

senses.sense_definition: A person who removes the scalp from another person's head.

examples.text: Old frontier tales often depicted the ruthless <w>scalper</w> who claimed gruesome trophies from his defeated enemies.
The historian detailed how each notorious <w>scalper</w> operated during the brutal border wars.

senses.sense_definition: A gambler who places opposing bets with different bookmakers to exploit differing odds and guarantee a profit.

examples.text: The clever <w>scalper</w> took advantage of differing point spreads across three different betting sites.
A cautious sports <w>scalper</w> locks in guaranteed gains regardless of who actually wins the game.

senses.sense_definition: A milling machine used to remove the ends of grain kernels or separate grades of crushed grain.

examples.text: The harvested wheat was transferred into a motorized <w>scalper</w> to separate debris from the grain.
Workers routinely cleaned the screens inside the mechanical <w>scalper</w> to ensure proper milling quality.

senses.sense_definition: A surgical instrument used for scraping diseased or decayed bone.

examples.text: The surgeon selected an antique <w>scalper</w> to scrape away the damaged section of the patient's femur.
Before modern drills were invented, a surgeon used a <w>scalper</w> to clean infected bone surfaces.
